summary: CucinaSmart AI Expo web-preview frontend E2E tested end-to-end against the public URL with viewport 390x844. All 11 requested flows PASSED: email/password login redirects to /oggi; Oggi renders greeting, KPI, today's menu, shortcuts; Ricette add-recipe appears in grid; Dispensa segments (pantry/fridge/freezer) switch, urgent (<=3d) item appears in 'Da usare prima', non-expiring in 'Tutto ok'; Spesa add/check/clear-checked works with correct aisle grouping; add-meal via Oggi slot appears both on Oggi and /calendar; Chef AI (Gemini) returned a real Italian reply; What-can-I-cook produced 3 suggestion cards and save-to-cookbook works; /import-photo screen renders (picker button present); Settings shows email chef@cucina.ai and logout returns to login screen. No red-screen errors, no page crashes, no failed app-issued API calls (only expected /api/auth/me 401s BEFORE login).

issues: React Native Web console warning: '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow"'. Emitted by shadow* styles in oggi.tsx/ricette.tsx/dispensa.tsx/spesa.tsx fab / kpi / card styles. Web-only warning, no visual impact but should be migrated to boxShadow for RNW compatibility.
React Native Web console warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'. Emitted by a library (likely react-native-safe-area-context/expo-image); safe to ignore.

action_items: Optional: replace RN shadow* style props with boxShadow (or platform-branch) to silence RNW deprecation warnings. Files: /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/oggi.tsx, ricette.tsx, dispensa.tsx, spesa.tsx (styles.fab, styles.kpi, styles.tabActive).

Optional: not tested (out of scope of this run) — recipe/[id] detail screen, favorite toggle on detail, cook/[id] step-by-step, and full import-photo OCR round-trip. The listing/list rendering and screens themselves load without error, but interactive behavior of detail/cook should be validated in a next pass if user reports issues.
critical_code_review_comments: Frontend code is well-structured with consistent testID attributes on all interactive elements (login inputs, tab bar, fabs, list rows, modals). Great for automated testing.
api.ts caches token in a module-level variable AND localStorage — after signOut sets token to null this works, but any parallel in-flight request could still use cached token; low risk on web.
Chef AI session_id is created per-mount with Date.now(); refreshing the chef screen starts a new AI session (history reset). Intentional per code but users may expect persistence across app restarts.
seed_data_creation: During this run the chef@cucina.ai account produced: 1 recipe titled 'TEST Pasta <timestamp>', 1 recipe saved from AI suggestion, 2 pantry items (TEST_Pomodori_urgent, TEST_Riso_ok), 1 meal 'TEST_PranzoOggi' for today, and Chef AI chat history under session chef_<ts>. Shopping item TEST_Mele was created and cleared.

Tab routes: /oggi /ricette /dispensa /spesa. Standalone routes: /chef /what-can-i-cook /import-photo /calendar /add-recipe /add-meal /settings /recipe/[id] /cook/[id]. AI endpoints take 5-25s. Not tested: recipe/[id] detail, favorite toggle, cook/[id] step flow, actual /import-photo OCR upload.
rca_of_issue: No blocking issues. The three [error] '401' entries in the browser console appear only on initial page load BEFORE the user has a token — they are the expected response from /api/auth/me being called by the AuthProvider check when no token exists (see /app/frontend/src/auth.tsx line 45-49). After login there are no further 401s. Not a bug.
